title: Cobblemon Do Enzão
description: A Cobblemon modpack (made for my friends) inspired by the official Cobblemon modpack with more Cobblemon mods and addons!
body:
# ENGLISH
A Cobblemon modpack inspired by the [Official Cobblemon Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblemon-fabric) with addons for Cobblemon and more mods to improve overall Minecraft experience, like Sophisticated Storage.

**_This is a modpack created for me and my friends, to make it easier to install/update._** But feel free to play this modpack as you want!

# PORTUGUESE
Um modpack de Cobblemon inspirado pelo modpack [Official Cobblemon Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblemon-fabric) com addons do Cobblemon e mais mods pra melhor experiência do Minecraft, com mods como Sophisticated Storage e Construction Wands.

**_Esse modpack foi criado com o intuito de ser jogado por mim e meus amigos, para facilitar a instalação e futuros updates._** Mas, fica a vontade para jogar esse modpack como quiser
